title: Golden Multi-Pack Narrative Compatibility Proof
objective: Close the CNI family with deterministic Golden Multi-Pack Narrative Compatibility proof using multiple original Multiversal fixture/first-party packs across the completed CNI-01..12 foundations while preserving canonical owner, visibility, rights and activation authorities.

scope.purpose: Prove the completed CNI family end to end with multiple original first-party packs without turning proof fixtures into canonical owner state or creating new sharing, marketplace, rights, visibility or runtime authority.
scope.completion_gate: Multiple original Multiversal packs deterministically exercise the completed CNI capability chain, including optional components, dependency ordering, character-aware dialogue, persistent NPC callbacks, quest/scene triggers, cross-pack extensions, localization switching, failed compatibility dry-run, successful activation, rollback/recovery and deterministic receipts, while failing closed on invalid states and preserving all existing owner/visibility/rights/runtime authority boundaries.

selection_boundaries: Owner Continue on 2026-09-16 governed-started CNI-13; implementation authority is limited to work/cni-13-golden-multi-pack-narrative-compatibility-proof.
CNI-01 through CNI-12 and MAS-01 through MAS-21 remain completed foundations and must not be silently reopened.
Golden proof must use original Multiversal fixture/first-party content; copyrighted Candlekeep/Baldur's Gate content is not authorized for proof fixtures.
CNI-13 is proof/integration scope only and must not create canonical owner-domain state authority, public sharing, marketplace, rights, visibility or parallel runtime authority.
PCA remains eligible under the current DAG but remains unselected until CNI-13 completion is reconciled; PCA-01, MSAS, SMB-08 and downstream work remain unauthorized.
next_action: Load only direct CNI-01..12 golden-proof seams and original fixture patterns, then establish causal CNI-13 RED before implementing the minimum deterministic proof evaluator.
